name: La Mole Comic Con
organizer: Es Hora de Golpear, S.A. de C.V.
blurb: Mexico's longest-running pop-culture convention, held at the World Trade Center Mexico City since 1995, with comics, anime and cosplay.

last.venue: World Trade Center (WTC) Ciudad de México

notes: This id covers the flagship La Mole Comic Con, not its 'La Mole Horror' sub-brand. The flagship's most recent run was its 30th-anniversary edition, 13-15 March 2026 at WTC México (confirmed via a news recap quoting the official announcement: 'del 13 al 15 de marzo de 2026 ... en el WTC México'), which is before today's window, so it is not listed. No 2027 flagship date has been confirmed on an official La Mole channel yet; one listings aggregator suggested 'March 12, 2027' but that could not be traced to an official La Mole announcement, so it is left out per the no-guessing rule rather than used. The shared lamole.com.mx domain currently promotes a separate, distinctly-branded event, 'La Mole Horror' (2nd edition), running 31 Oct - 1 Nov 2026 with its own logo and guest lineup (Pedro Delgado & Diego Olascoaga, Ponzoña, Mike Sandoval, ¡Qué Chido Nihon!, Hato Joestar, Werevita, Hidden y Bustio, BYD Cosplay, and several artist-alley names) — since it is a differently-named spin-off rather than another edition of 'La Mole Comic Con' itself, it is left out of this file rather than guessed into it; it may deserve its own id in a later batch. Organizer is taken from the site's own footer copyright line ('Copyright © 1995 – 2024 | Es Hora de Golpear, S.A. de C.V.'). Cover uses the generic 'La Mole Convention' logo (alt text 'La Mole Convention') rather than the Horror-branded key art currently on the homepage, since that art represents the different sub-event. 2026-10-05 fixup pass: homepage re-checked fresh, still only promoting "La Mole Horror Second Edition"; WebSearch found no official flagship 2027 date. Recorded the confirmed 30th-anniversary edition (13-15 March 2026, WTC México) as "last".
